basis: Current staged factory source and exact Astra79-family meanings; static review, not a new emission or real-data audit
sourcePathsReviewed: B/CHANGED-PATHS.json plus existing baseline family factories

families.title: Map, side, account, hero and team identity
families.meaning: Bind account, hero, side and team; hash roster and draft. Array order never proves role.
families.detail: Current identity and row capability metadata; not continuous nominal strength.

families.title: Partial and late roster disclosure
families.meaning: Known flags and coverage; account disclosure at t1 creates a validFrom revision while retaining history cutoff t0.
families.detail: Disclosure/support metadata and masks; no invented account IDs.

families.title: Proven roles and distinct economic ranks
families.meaning: Farm roles 1-5 require evidence; NW/GPM ranks 1-5 and historical lane categories 1-4 are separate.
families.detail: Economic ranks implemented separately; farm roles require retained role evidence.

families.title: Format, tournament, region, schedule and rest
families.meaning: Known BO format, wins required and map number; rest days, recent match counts and versioned league/tier/region.
families.detail: Series format and target identity supported; tournament/tier/region/rest completeness remains source-dependent.

families.title: Historical team strength and uncertainty
families.meaning: Chronological result rating and expected win, with support and uncertainty; preserve side differences.
families.detail: Causal chronological team result reference K32 implemented; no learned uncertainty or intrinsic-skill claim.

families.title: Team form, streaks and recent trend
families.meaning: Raw and explicitly smoothed win fractions over 7/30/90 days, streaks, weighted recent-minus-long trends and support.
families.detail: Existing canonical partial source factories remain; this static ledger does not assert full-family numeric coverage or source95 acceptance.

families.title: Head-to-head and prior opponent strength
families.meaning: Weighted head-to-head win fractions and support; result/performance residual against a historically available expectation.
families.detail: Directional team-pair cohorts present; prior-opponent pre-map expectation residual still requires its causal state.

families.title: Roster continuity and shared experience
families.meaning: Overlap with previous N rosters, stability and days together; distribution of shared distinct-map counts.
families.detail: Last complete-roster overlap/Jaccard, shared maps and change age implemented by chronological reference.

families.title: Individual player form
families.meaning: Raw and explicitly smoothed win fractions over 7/30/90 days, trends and roster min/max/SD/quantiles.
families.detail: Existing canonical partial source factories remain; this static ledger does not assert full-family numeric coverage or source95 acceptance.

families.title: Selected player-hero form and comfort
families.meaning: Win fractions over 30/90 days and lifetime, effective support, pick share, days since last pick and hero-minus-player form.
families.detail: Existing canonical partial source factories remain; this static ledger does not assert full-family numeric coverage or source95 acceptance.

families.title: Individual result-rating proxy
families.meaning: Chronological player result Elo/Glicko, uncertainty and support; these do not measure personal MMR or mechanical skill.
families.detail: Causal five-account-lineup result reference K32 implemented; not personal MMR.

families.title: Historical player performance
families.meaning: Past observed GPM/XPM, hero/tower damage per minute, deaths/minute, KDA, last hits/minute and wards/minute over 30/90 days.
families.detail: Existing canonical partial source factories remain; this static ledger does not assert full-family numeric coverage or source95 acceptance.

families.title: Player-hero performance relative to self and population
families.meaning: Player-hero minus hero-population mean, divided by available population SD; player-hero minus player and 7/30 versus 90-day trends.
families.detail: Existing canonical partial source factories remain; this static ledger does not assert full-family numeric coverage or source95 acceptance.

families.title: Player by team by hero
families.meaning: Player-team lift, selected-hero-in-team lift and (player-team-hero minus player-team) minus (player-hero minus player).
families.detail: Existing canonical partial source factories remain; this static ledger does not assert full-family numeric coverage or source95 acceptance.

families.title: Player resource efficiency and pressure
families.meaning: Historical hero/tower damage, GPM and deaths ratios; damage/GPM and opponent-pressure cross-products with explicit units.
families.detail: Existing canonical partial source factories remain; this static ledger does not assert full-family numeric coverage or source95 acceptance.

families.title: Roster profile distributions
families.meaning: Quartiles, min/max/SD, coverage, all 25 opposing player comparisons, dominance and overlap; role pairing requires proof.
families.detail: Existing canonical partial source factories remain; this static ledger does not assert full-family numeric coverage or source95 acceptance.

families.title: Team late-game duration tendency
families.meaning: Historical fraction with duration at least 40 minutes over 90 days with support at least 5; retain proposed threshold curves 25-80 and quantiles.
families.detail: Existing canonical partial source factories remain; this static ledger does not assert full-family numeric coverage or source95 acceptance.

families.title: Player, hero and player-hero late-game tendency
families.meaning: Three separate 90-day fractions with duration at least 40 minutes; hero population includes known heroes with anonymous accounts.
families.detail: Existing canonical partial source factories remain; this static ledger does not assert full-family numeric coverage or source95 acceptance.

families.title: Observed draft identities and bans
families.meaning: Signed hero one-hot; picks, bans, slots and order only when actually observed. Known unpicked zero differs from unknown draft.
families.detail: Selected side/hero identities implemented; bans/order require explicit retained fields.

families.title: Historical hero strength and popularity
families.meaning: Hero win fraction, pick share and ban rate with 30/90-day decay and effective counts; raw and smoothed estimates remain distinct.
families.detail: Existing canonical partial source factories remain; this static ledger does not assert full-family numeric coverage or source95 acceptance.

families.title: Allied hero pairs
families.meaning: Pair identities plus historical pair win fraction, support, decay and lift relative to hero marginal rates.
families.detail: Existing canonical partial source factories remain; this static ledger does not assert full-family numeric coverage or source95 acceptance.

families.title: Directed counters and protective bans
families.meaning: Directed hero A against hero B historical win fractions; weighted mean/min counter and removal of an adverse matchup by a known ban.
families.detail: Existing canonical partial source factories remain; this static ledger does not assert full-family numeric coverage or source95 acceptance.

families.title: Team-hero comfort pool
families.meaning: Team-hero win fraction, support and pick share; selected-draft comfort and undrafted pool summaries use distinct definitions.
families.detail: Existing canonical partial source factories remain; this static ledger does not assert full-family numeric coverage or source95 acceptance.

families.title: Patch and letter revision meta
families.meaning: Patch-conditioned pick/ban/win rates and 7/30/90-day trends; old-to-new patch change, uncertainty, side and proven-role strata.
families.detail: Letter-patch-specific meta needs proved patch identity plus as-of population; calendar inference separate.

families.title: Pro, Immortal, regional and role populations
families.meaning: Separate meta rates and residuals by declared population/rank/region/role; transfer priors only with an explicit namespace.
families.detail: Retained pro cohort cannot be relabeled Immortal/region/role population.

families.title: Hero mechanics and rules version
families.meaning: Versioned hero attributes, ability types, scaling, push/save/control descriptors and patch-valid facets/innates.
families.detail: Qualified patch-specific mechanics rules absent for the full intended inventory.

families.title: Allied player pairs
families.meaning: Conditional result/performance for account A and B; raw/smoothed rates, lift versus individuals and 30/90-day distinct-map support.
families.detail: Existing canonical partial source factories remain; this static ledger does not assert full-family numeric coverage or source95 acceptance.

families.title: Player-hero with a specific ally
families.meaning: Result/performance for account A on hero A given ally account B, minus the account-hero baseline.
families.detail: Existing canonical partial source factories remain; this static ledger does not assert full-family numeric coverage or source95 acceptance.

families.title: Player-hero with an allied hero
families.meaning: Conditional account A, hero A and ally hero B, compared with own-hero and hero-pair baselines.
families.detail: Existing canonical partial source factories remain; this static ledger does not assert full-family numeric coverage or source95 acceptance.

families.title: Two specified players on two heroes
families.meaning: Conditional account A/hero A/account B/hero B with a symmetric teammate key; opposing variants stay separate.
families.detail: Existing canonical partial source factories remain; this static ledger does not assert full-family numeric coverage or source95 acceptance.

families.title: Individual opposition and hero triples
families.meaning: Player-hero versus opponent player-hero, team triples/archetypes and separate additive versus conditional residuals.
families.detail: Existing canonical partial source factories remain; this static ledger does not assert full-family numeric coverage or source95 acceptance.

families.title: Historical team tempo and aggression
families.meaning: Kills/deaths per played minute, early engagements, farm-versus-fight and tempo distributions; name proxies explicitly.
families.detail: Existing canonical partial source factories remain; this static ledger does not assert full-family numeric coverage or source95 acceptance.

families.title: Historical item, ward and buyback style
families.meaning: Past observed Blink/BKB/Midas/Battlefury/Radiance purchase timing and shares, ward and buyback rates.
families.detail: Historical ward/native performance exists; full item/buyback event timing distributions need event histories.

families.title: Results against opponent style
families.meaning: Similarity-weighted result/style residual against historically available opponent style, expectation and supported response cohorts.
families.detail: Approved scalar opponent-pace kernel has target pace and final historical maps, but no bound per-prior-map prematch pace/expectation closure at that prior horizon. See B/REQUIRED-FAMILY-INPUTS.json; final rates and post-result states cannot substitute.

families.title: Draft compatibility with team style
families.meaning: Team style minus hero-draft profile, player-hero comfort style and draft against the known opponent context.
families.detail: Exact same-team marginal versus all-five team-hero conditional style contrasts implemented.

families.title: Closing speed and late-game style
families.meaning: Historical time to close conditional on earlier advantage/minute/draft/Roshan, high-ground conversion and median/upper quartile.
families.detail: Approved prior90d raw-native landmark10/20/30min NWlead>=1000/deficit<=-1000 producer and96historical columns added. Requires explicit durationKnownAt and qualified prior raw frames; remainingduration=finalduration-landmark; anchorlag separate. PRE/BETWEEN static histories without prior-native modality remain missing, not equivalent snapshots.

families.title: Form by current trajectory
families.meaning: Form by current score leader/recovery/hero/minute and style by momentum; preserve independent main effects.
families.detail: Current lead trajectory times exact frozen team form/late/closing products;720 ambiguous bindings corrected.

families.title: Observed clock, score and phase
families.meaning: Elapsed seconds/minutes/log/minute-80 clip, side kills, difference, total and rate; phase flags require valid admission.
families.detail: Existing canonical partial source factories remain; this static ledger does not assert full-family numeric coverage or source95 acceptance.

families.title: Native per-hero net worth
families.meaning: Observed NW, log1p, team share, centered values, team/side summaries and hero by NW by minute.
families.detail: Literal net_worth supported;9,232 gold/net_gold descendants per LIVE head remain opaque diagnostic vocabulary.

families.title: Native per-hero GPM and XPM
families.meaning: Observed native GPM/XPM, shares, centered values and minute/context products; NW divided by time is not GPM.
families.detail: Existing canonical partial source factories remain; this static ledger does not assert full-family numeric coverage or source95 acceptance.

families.title: Observed levels and XP thresholds
families.meaning: Observed level/team differences; XP-to-next and ability thresholds require raw XP plus versioned rules.
families.detail: Literal level supported; XP thresholds still need actual XP plus patch-specific rules.

families.title: Economic rank and resource distribution
families.meaning: NW/GPM ranks 1-5, rank-pair gaps, HHI, top share, spread and median; rank never implies farm role.
families.detail: Existing canonical partial source factories remain; this static ledger does not assert full-family numeric coverage or source95 acceptance.

families.title: Hero-minute economic reference deviations
families.meaning: Observed native metric minus past hero-minute mean, with SD-based z score, support and explicit windows.
families.detail: Prior native_level producer added to populate existing500 level residual/z outputs; no duplicate outputs.

families.title: Reconstructed earned-gold and XP prefixes
families.meaning: Cumulative earned gold/XP prefix slopes, shares and hero/context interactions; keep this source profile distinct from net worth.
families.detail: OpenDota earned-resource prefixes remain distinct from native Steam NW/GPM and not Steam-only live equivalent.

families.title: Observed trajectories and actual gaps
families.meaning: Deltas over actual time gaps for 60/120/180/300/600-second windows; report true span/count and remain missing without prefix support.
families.detail: Appended3000 canonical per-hero NW/GPM/XPM window-rate columns; no second temporal calculation.

families.title: Lead retention and recovery
families.meaning: Min/max lead, sign changes, recovery from minimum, retreat from maximum, time since lead change and short-long momentum.
families.detail: Observed lead suffix summaries preserve exact anchors, receipt order and missingness.

families.title: Current per-player combat and farm
families.meaning: Observed kills/deaths/assists, death rate, last hits/denies, participation and hero/context residuals.
families.detail: Existing canonical partial source factories remain; this static ledger does not assert full-family numeric coverage or source95 acceptance.

families.title: Alive heroes, health, mana and return times
families.meaning: Observed alive counts, respawn timers, weighted absence, health/mana ratios and staggered returns.
families.detail: Raw respawn timer remains opaque; health/mana/proved life-state source qualification incomplete.

families.title: Ultimates and key abilities
families.meaning: Observed readiness/cooldown windows and teamfight ability availability with patch-valid hero-ability mapping.
families.detail: Observed raw ultimate enum/cooldown diagnostic only until mechanical semantics qualified.

families.title: Items, backpack, neutral slots and consumables
families.meaning: Observed per-hero item identities and semantic groups, BKB/Blink/save/dispel/break/counter items with distinct slots.
families.detail: Literal GLG six slots only; not full inventory/backpack/neutral slots.

families.title: Hero and draft resource power timings
families.meaning: Hero by level/items/NW/minute, distance to historical thresholds and five-player power distributions/matchups.
families.detail: Historical/rank/hero/current-resource interactions; exact sorting clock and selector inputs added.

families.title: Buyback and death consequences
families.meaning: Observed buyback availability/cost/cooldown, dead hero by buyback by high-ground risk and native unreliable gold if present.
families.detail: Literal has_buyback/raw timer retained but semantic availability/cost/rules unqualified.

families.title: Positions, zones and prospective engagements
families.meaning: Same-frame positions to team spread, objective distance and heroes near Roshan/high-ground using versioned geometry.
families.detail: Raw coordinates retained; no qualified coordinate transform or geometric interpretation.

families.title: Vision, wards, smoke and map control
families.meaning: Observed ward/smoke states, coverage/expiry and objective vision, using only prefix event logs.
families.detail: Existing canonical partial source factories remain; this static ledger does not assert full-family numeric coverage or source95 acceptance.

families.title: Structures and exposed high ground
families.meaning: Verified native decoder for lane structures alive/destroyed, exposed tiers/base, lane asymmetry and lead by conversion.
families.detail: Raw structures are not a qualified lane/tier/alive decoder; source/rule contract still required.

families.title: Other objectives and day/night
families.meaning: Patch-valid Tormentor/rune/Wisdom/Lotus availability, windows, control, day/night and known objective history.
families.detail: Existing canonical partial source factories remain; this static ledger does not assert full-family numeric coverage or source95 acceptance.

families.title: Lane pressure and ability to finish
families.meaning: Observed creep/wave positions if available; alive push heroes by items, structures, Aegis and historical team closing style.
families.detail: Existing canonical partial source factories remain; this static ledger does not assert full-family numeric coverage or source95 acceptance.

families.title: Raw Roshan timer semantics
families.meaning: Retain the raw timer and separate semantic proof; zero never proves alive and a countdown is not an absolute event time.
families.detail: Raw timer diagnostics do not certify respawn seconds or alive.

families.title: Roshan death, respawn and uncertain intervals
families.meaning: Confirmed events to elapsed time; patch min/max rules to earliest/latest respawn; inferred intervals stay separately named.
families.detail: Qualified event/rule death and respawn intervals supported when supplied.

families.title: Aegis holder, side, lifetime and consumption
families.meaning: Observed pickup to holder/side; known lifetime to expiry; consumed, lost and expired remain distinct.
families.detail: Qualified current holder/episode terminal context supported; prior Aegis conversion histories not implemented.

families.title: Aegis steal and separate killer/picker
families.meaning: Compare proven Roshan killer side with Aegis picker side or a direct snatch event; retain contested-fight context.
families.detail: Steal requires exact death/pickup side linkage; no inferred theft from mere possession.

families.title: Roshan ordinal and rewards
families.meaning: Known completed Roshan count and patch-valid reward availability and beneficiary context.
families.detail: Confirmed objective event counts exist via R02; ordinal/reward semantics need qualified event/rule history.

families.title: Roshan by economy, form and closing style
families.meaning: Respawn window/Aegis time by NW/GPM/score/level difference by frozen form/style, preserving side asymmetry.
families.detail: Qualified current objective x coherent economy x frozen finishing-style context shared by all four LIVE heads.

families.title: Roshan-taking and contest strength
families.meaning: Observed hero/items/ultimate/alive composition near the pit and historical Roshan speed, contest and steal tendencies.
families.detail: No qualified Roshan-taking/contest power metric; retain explicit source gap.

families.title: Series score and wins required
families.meaning: Known BO format, team1/team2 score and wins required, map position and terminal state; current sides bind separately.
families.detail: Existing canonical partial source factories remain; this static ledger does not assert full-family numeric coverage or source95 acceptance.

families.title: Completed previous series maps
families.meaning: Previously received winner/duration/kills/lead trajectory/draft/items/style/strength residuals and latest available summaries.
families.detail: Existing canonical partial source factories remain; this static ledger does not assert full-family numeric coverage or source95 acceptance.

families.title: Historical recovery and reverse sweeps
families.meaning: Past probability of next win given previous loss, expectation, format and roster; recovery pace and comeback counts.
families.detail: Historical series recovery/reverse-sweep cohorts not implemented by this track.

families.title: Draft adaptation between maps
families.meaning: Prior draft exposures to changes in observed bans/picks, repeat heroes and roster disclosures; future draft stays unknown.
families.detail: Eight current-series pick-based adaptation outputs already exist in seriesContextFeatures.mjs: own-team prior hero variety/draft coverage/current repeats/novelty. Bans lack qualified input; exact additional opponent-change variants need reviewed definitions. Partial prior drafts do not prove globally never-used heroes.

families.title: Map probability and contextual series branches
families.meaning: Additional versioned map probability; conditional series branches or a direct series model retain the full admissible rich shared context.
families.detail: Future causal out-of-fold map probability/series branches; no model run or fitted prior generated.

families.title: Earlier model estimate as an extra prior
families.meaning: Versioned earlier probability/logit with support and uncertainty, separate from the complete historical vector; future OOF binding required.
families.detail: Future out-of-fold predecessor-model prior; training remains paused.

families.title: Complete shared series context
families.meaning: All admissible player/hero/team history, form/style, current observed draft/live state, previous maps, format/score, recovery and adaptation; phase/source/time masks preserve scope.
families.detail: Composition of series score/format/history/current-map context, not filler numeric columns.

families.title: Historical kill and duration distributions
families.meaning: Team/player/hero/style means, SD, quantiles and tail fractions, conditional on admissible context; previous maps only after receipt.
families.detail: Historical duration/kill summaries composed from H13/H14/outcome statistics; no new model quality claim.

families.title: Live finishing risk and kill intensity
families.meaning: Remaining hazard conditioned on current clock/score/economy/Roshan/structures/style, recent kill tempo and lulls.
families.detail: Current score/clock/resources/objects are covariates for future fitted risk/intensity models; no current fit.

families.title: Candidate axis and distribution support
families.meaning: Final or remaining count/time candidate crossed with state, monotone CDF, observed lower bound, push mass and right tail.
families.detail: Candidate-axis deterministic distribution constraints kept; not probability quality.

families.title: Bookmaker markets and own line grid
families.meaning: Own grid derived from the coherent model CDF; chosen bookmaker lines evaluated with our CDF, with separate odds/push/settlement metadata.
families.detail: Own versus bookmaker grids are presentation/market routing; no synthetic bookmaker odds.

families.title: Completeness, masks, support and uncertainty
families.meaning: Value, missingness, exact support and effective sample size; distinguish structural zero and unknown; joint availability includes failed attempts.
families.detail: Existing canonical partial source factories remain; this static ledger does not assert full-family numeric coverage or source95 acceptance.

families.title: Latency, clock gaps and source eligibility
families.meaning: Receipt age, measured event delay where proven, actual prefix gaps and profile/phase admission; cross-stream gaps do not prove event latency.
families.detail: Existing canonical partial source factories remain; this static ledger does not assert full-family numeric coverage or source95 acceptance.

families.title: Patch, causal basis and provenance
families.meaning: Recorded/reconstructed status, exact availability, source/hash/transform/fold binding and patch-assignment provenance.
families.detail: Existing canonical partial source factories remain; this static ledger does not assert full-family numeric coverage or source95 acceptance.

families.title: Current-map labels and final metrics
families.meaning: Current winner/final kills/final duration belong only to label/evaluator joins; changing a label must not change earlier features.
families.detail: Current final outcomes/statistics are labels only, never early-current-map features.
